issues.description: ArrayHelpers helper method name is inconsistent between the template and other artifacts. In the template repository, ArrayHelpers declares a method named appendElement(T[] array, T element) (signature at src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java line 13). However, the template's Stock.addToStockIngredients calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) (call located at src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java line 19), and the solution repository provides ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) (signature at solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java line 13). This naming mismatch (appendElement vs addElementToArray) causes a compilation error for students using the provided template and prevents use of the helper method as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent across the template and solution. Rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) so it matches the call sites in Stock and the solution implementation. Alternatively, change calls to ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) in the template (e.g., in Stock.addToStockIngredients) to call ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...), but prefer renaming the template method to addElementToArray to align with the solution and example usages.
